flows.title: Switch between your sites
steps: Open the account dashboard, which displays all sites, domains and other subscriptions connected to your account.
In the dashboard tab, each site shows its preview image, title, primary domain and account status.
Browse for the site you need, hover over its preview image and click Go To Website to open it in the same browser tab.
To reach a site through its domain instead, click Domains, click ... beside the domain, then click Manage Domain Settings to open its connected site.
